# Compatibility fixtures

Frozen, never regenerated by the test suite. v1 was written by the unmodified 0.0.2 engine before implementing 0.2.0. v2 contains f32 and int8 collections, metadata and a tombstone. The WAL adds `journal` to the int8 collection of the v2 snapshot. Producers are included for provenance, not for replacing expected files when tests fail.
